ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: stable_normalized_pairwise_loss_with_clamp
ir.intuition: This loss stabilizes training by clamping the margin to prevent extreme logits causing numeric instability and normalizing the advantage gap to ensure scale-invariance. Clamping the margin bounds the sigmoid input, reducing gradient explosions, while normalizing advantage_gap adapts the loss to varied scales. Weighting remains optional and the final loss is averaged for stable gradients.
ir.pseudocode:
advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
log_prob_w = batch['log_prob_w']
log_prob_l = batch['log_prob_l']
weight = batch.get('weight', None)

alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.5)))
clip_val = float(extra.get('clip_val', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('clip_val', 10.0)))
epsilon = 1e-6

norm_factor = ops.maximum(ops.norm(advantage_gap), epsilon)
normalized_adv = ops.div(advantage_gap, norm_factor)

margin = ops.sub(ops.sub(log_prob_w, log_prob_l), ops.mul(beta, advantage_gap))
clamped_margin = ops.clamp(margin, -clip_val, clip_val)
scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, clamped_margin)
loss_sigmoid = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(scaled_margin))
modifier = ops.sigmoid(ops.mul(alpha, normalized_adv))
refined_loss = ops.mul(modifier, loss_sigmoid)

if weight is not None:
    refined_loss = ops.mul(refined_loss, weight)

loss = ops.mean(refined_loss)
return loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.5)))
    clip_val = float(extra.get('clip_val', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('clip_val', 10.0)))
    epsilon = 1e-6
    norm_factor = ops.maximum(ops.norm(adv), epsilon)
    normalized_adv = ops.div(adv, norm_factor)
    margin = ops.sub(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), ops.mul(beta, adv))
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(margin, -clip_val, clip_val)
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, clamped_margin)
    loss_sigmoid = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(scaled_margin))
    modifier = ops.sigmoid(ops.mul(alpha, normalized_adv))
    refined_loss = ops.mul(modifier, loss_sigmoid)
    if weight is not None:
        refined_loss = ops.mul(refined_loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(refined_loss)
